releaseNotes: NEW: IMAGE CLICKER — teach your phone to click by picture, PC-style. Open the new IMAGE CLICKER card on the cloner home: record your taps live, or drag a box around any button in a screenshot and the clicker learns it (image recognition, works even if the button moves). Build sequences: tap here, wait, swipe, IF the image appears tap it, loop forever with random intervals. A tiny control pill shows while it runs (drag it, tap to expand play/pause/stop) — nothing floats when you're not running anything.

SWITCHER v6 — DISCORD ONLY, YOUR WAY: the always-visible floating ⇄ button is gone (it irritated). In Discord clones you now switch accounts by HOLDING your profile tab (bottom-right, ~half a second) — or tap the quiet top notification's ⇄ Switch account action while the clone is open. Same quick menu as before: switch accounts, set status, update the clone.

OTHER APPS (Roblox, WhatsApp, etc.): their own built-in account switchers stay untouched — Ophelia no longer adds anything inside non-Discord clones. If an older clone still has the floating button, Update-all below removes it.
UPDATE-ALL now also fixes old clones: Discord clones get the new hold + notification switcher, and clones of other apps get the old floating button REMOVED — in place, logins and data untouched.

IF PLAY PROTECT BLOCKS THIS UPDATE (“Harmful app blocked”, no Install-anyway): Play Store → your profile picture → Play Protect → gear → turn OFF “Scan apps with Play Protect” → tap Update again. That verdict is Google's server-side call on apps that re-sign other apps (the original App Cloner has been flagged the same way for years) — nothing in the app changed to cause it. You can turn scanning back on afterwards.
switcherReleaseNotes: dex v6 — DISCORD-ONLY: the v5 draggable bubble is retired. Entry points: (a) profile-tab hold zone (400ms, replay-safe), (b) quiet persistent notification (IMPORTANCE_LOW, alive only while the clone is on screen, tap or its action opens the quick menu). Non-Discord clones get NO switcher dex at all.

OpheliaSwitchNotification: framework-only APIs (no androidx in the dex), RECEIVER_EXPORTED on 33+, dynamic receiver resolves the current activity; notification channel 'ophelia_switcher', silent, no badge.
Update engine unchanged (feed check + source-package meta-data); DEX_VERSION 5→6; selfcheck now asserts OpheliaSwitchNotification + ophelia.switcher.OPEN present AND OpheliaBubble absent.
